services.desc: Our Most Popular Tour! Our Tikis Boat Cruise is perfect for all types of occasions, from birthdays and bachelorette parties to corporate events and family gatherings. With our customizable route, you can even request specific destinations to visit on your tour. At the end of your journey, you'll return to the dock with unforgettable memories and stunning photos to share with your loved ones. Book your Tikis Boat Cruise today and experience Bay St. Louis in a way you never thought possible. Cruise Type: BYOB Public Cruise Duration: 90 minutes Boat Capacity: 2-6 guests
